- **Shape**: draft → `main`, first line **`Fixes #4697`** — full deliverable; #4699 referenced bare. Scope (10 files): the 9 named test files + the tests-only empty-frontmatter changeset the presence gate demanded — no production source, exactly the boundary.
- **Acceptance met as measured**: per-file baselines reproduced exactly (70/40/12/12/12/12/8/8/6 = 180), all to 0 isolated, with every assertion count unchanged (60 tests). The directory and full-area suites confirm nothing else moved. Reverse verification on the biggest file returned exactly to its 70-line baseline with tests green — proving the stub, not something else, silences the noise.
- **Mechanism quality**: the stable-identity stub reasoning (the hooks' effects key on `[client, …]`, so a fresh object per render would re-fire them) is the detail that separates a correct double from a subtly-flaky one; the no-shared-helper call is fine at this size.
- **Out-of-scope finding**: #4699 (FlowCanvas `ECONNRESET` — a different transport mechanism, 19 lines) — correctly filed, not folded; graded on its own card.

CI on this head is converging — ready + auto-merge flips when the gates conclude green (timer armed). Card closes on merge; `pm:dispatched` comes off then. With this and PRs #4689/#4698, the entire measured ECONNREFUSED noise across the four packages is attributed and closed.
